a.xlink:title: Count the instructions a subtree emits (shared subtrees count per use).
Emit postfix code for a subtree and track the stack depth it needs.
Skip whitespace before the next token.
Record the first parse error with its position; later ones are consequences.
Consume token if it is next, and report whether it was.
Append a node to the pool and return its index, or -1 once an error is set.
sum (comparison sum)*; a chain a < b < c is (a < b) and (b < c).
Parses a left-associative chain of + and -, folding each operator into a node.
Parses a left-associative chain of *, /, %, folding each operator into a node.
Parses a sign prefix recursively and wraps the operand in a negate or identity node.
Parses an atom and, when a power operator follows, appends a power node.
